We'll also recognize several people and businesses that have had an impact over the past year.

Description Hear directly from the IRS on topics to help your business succeed. Join us in a conversation on how the IRS can better serve small businesses and SelfEmployed taxpayers and discuss issues or concerns you have when preparing and paying taxes. Topics include estimated tax payments, recordkeeping, preventing identity theft, what to expect during an audit or collection visit, employment tax issues and the Taxpayer First Act - we want to know how we can improve our service to small business owners.
